FR-FLOW-009 AC-5: 'The release clears only the Lockout state and leaves every login throttle key as it was (decided 2026-11-02; SEC-FLOW-012 AC-6)', and SEC-FLOW-012 AC-6: 'the same new-device login right after another admin's DELETE /auth/admin/users/:id/lockout still gets 429 from the user-only key'. 00 R34 (4) ties DELETE …/lockout to the hard lock only, so 00 is internally ambiguous; the decision picks R34 (4) and voids the §6.4 remedy.
